result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: a text layout overlap in the restaurant listing metadata that makes the details hard to read.

issues.description: In the "Tokumaru Ramen Bar" card, the delivery time and delivery-fee line appear to overlap/crowd together, with text visually colliding instead of spacing cleanly.
issues.suggestion: Increase horizontal spacing or let the metadata wrap onto a second line so the delivery time, fee, and cuisine label remain clearly separated and readable.
